fusions.name: Scattershot
fusions.desc: Looses 5 stingers in a wide fan at once, each dealing 5 damage. Holds up to 4 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Report
fusions.desc: Fires a stinger that deals 36 damage and always crits. It then leaps to 3 more enemies within 3.5 tiles, each hit dealing 50% of the original damage.

fusions.name: Covering Fire
fusions.desc: Increases your damage by 30% for 15 seconds. A volley of stingers fights beside you for 10 seconds, striking for 4 every 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Ricochet
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, a stinger leaps to the nearest enemy within 6 tiles, dealing 7 damage, then to 1 more within 3.5 tiles for 70% of that. Once every 5 seconds.
